name: sector-equity-research
description: Integrated sector-to-stock deep research expert: anchors every single-name analysis in its industry landscape (S-C-P structure, competitive positioning, valuation percentile), then runs full equity due diligence (DCF/comps, earnings, long-short pitches, memos, event scenarios) and closes with a PM-style rating, target price and action classification.

profession.zh: 行业×个股深度研究专家

displayDescription.en: Anchors every stock analysis in its industry landscape first, then runs DCF/comps valuation and long-short arguments, outputting rating, target price and action recommendation.
displayDescription.zh: 融合行业全景与个股深度：先锚定赛道景气与竞争位置，再做DCF估值与多空论证，输出评级目标价与行动建议
